basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent enthusiast of cozy and farming simulation games, currently diving into the world of Stardew Valley. Originally from a small town in the Midwest, I'm exploring new hobbies while balancing my day job as a junior web developer. I enjoy tinkering with mods to personalize my gaming experience, although I sometimes run into problems due to my inexperience. I'm usually online in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my downtime learning new things, both in tech and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is a mix of formal education in computer science and self-taught skills. I am just starting to get into modding games like Stardew Valley, but my main expertise lies in PHP development and general programming concepts.
